mapper.select: SELECT event_id, provider, event_type, invoice_id, payload_hash, processing_status, received_at, processed_at, error_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM webhook_processed WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webhook_processed (event_id, provider, event_type, payload_hash, processing_status, received_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{provider}, #{eventType}, #{payloadHash}, 'RECEIVED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE webhook_processed SET processing_status = 'PROCESSED', invoice_id = #{invoiceId}, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE webhook_processed SET processing_status = 'FAILED', error_reason = #{errorReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
